notes:
Cut Valet 1.1.62 - 2026-08-16

Fixes
- Fixed a crash on quit while a slate scan was still running (the recurring
  shutdown abort - reported in a mac diagnostics bundle, seen x2).
- Model Storage Location is honest now: downloading models right after
  picking a new location warns you to restart first instead of silently
  putting them back on the system drive - and the Private AI engine
  (Ollama) now follows your chosen location too.
- The Metadata progress bar reaches 100% when the work is actually done -
  photos and adopted clips no longer hold it at ~90% forever.

Tools
- MCP: copying the connect command now turns the server on, with live
  status shown in the agent box.
